init.title: Add New Chat or Contact
init.description:
Create a new SimpleX alias connection.

1. Open SimpleX Chat app
2. Create/share an invite link
3. Paste the link below with a friendly name

Note: You can view and manage existing entities in Settings → Devices & Services → Entities.

data.alias: Friendly name (e.g., Alice, Family Group, Security)

error.invite_failed: Could not accept the invite link.
error.invite_invalid: This invite link looks invalid. Please paste a fresh link.
error.invite_expired: This invite link has expired or was revoked. Generate a new one.
error.invite_timeout: Timed out waiting for SimpleX to respond. Ensure the SimpleX CLI WebSocket is running and reachable.
error.ws_not_connected: The WebSocket is not connected. Check the connection in the integration settings.
error.alias_exists: This alias already exists. Please choose a different name.
error.unknown: Unknown error occurred. Please check the logs for details.
